snapshot.name: Titan Company Ltd
snapshot.about: Titan Company Ltd is among India’s most respected lifestyle companies. It has established leadership positions in the Watches, Jewellery and Eyewear categories led by its trusted brands and differentiated customer experience. It was founded in 1984 as a joint-venture between TATA Group and Tamilnadu Industrial Development Corporation (TIDCO). [1]

business_mix.what_it_does: Titan Company Limited is a leading Indian lifestyle company primarily operating in the jewellery, watches, and eyewear segments with brands like Tanishq, Mia, Zoya, and CaratLane.

segments.name: Jewellery
segments.note: Includes brands like Tanishq, Mia, Zoya, and CaratLane, focusing on plain gold and studded jewellery.

guidance.statement: CaratLane EBIT margin should gradually inch up from 8% to 9% and further over the next couple of years.
guidance.quote: gradually their EBIT margin should start inching up from 8% to 9%, and then further from there in next couple of years.
guidance.speaker: Ashok Sonthalia

guidance.statement: We would like to anchor our margin target at around 11% for FY27.
guidance.quote: anchor our margin target at around 11%. We would not, as far as FY27 is concerned, change our stance on margins.
guidance.speaker: Ashok Sonthalia

guidance.statement: Jewellery business margin center of gravity will be around 11% plus/minus.
guidance.quote: more of 11% being the center of gravity for jewellery business margin, we would be around that plus/minus something can happen.
guidance.speaker: Ashok Sonthalia

guidance.statement: International business except Damas will make mid-single-digit EBIT margins of 5% - 6% and overall portfolio will turn out positive EBIT for the full year.
guidance.quote: international business, except Damas is making profit mid-single-digit EBIT margin, 5% - 6%, which they will continue to make. So I would expect overall portfolio would still turn out to be positive EBIT performance for the full year.
guidance.speaker: Ashok Sonthalia

guidance.statement: Targeting a double-digit aggressive growth in jewellery.
guidance.quote: we are targeting, as always, a double-digit aggressive growth, and that's something which we shared even in the Investor Day.
guidance.speaker: Ajoy Chawla

guidance.statement: TEAL normalized margin would gradually gravitate towards 12% to 15%, 16% in the long term.
guidance.quote: normalized margin would be gradually gravitating towards 12% to 15%, 16%.
guidance.speaker: Ashok Sonthalia

guidance.statement: CaratLane should gradually inch towards double-digit EBIT margin, around 10% or 11%.
guidance.quote: CaratLane should inch towards double-digit EBIT margin, more like Tanishq kind of margin it's there.
guidance.speaker: Ashok Sonthalia

guidance.statement: Committed to a double-digit healthy growth in value in the jewellery business to get to FY30 goals.
guidance.quote: we are committed to a double -digit healthy growth in value in the jewellery business. So that's the only way we'll get to our committed FY 30 goals
guidance.speaker: Ajoy Chawla

guidance.statement: Management expects to maintain a 15% to 20% revenue growth over the next three to four years.
guidance.quote: Think of it over the next three to four years, what should be the growth.
guidance.speaker: Ajoy Chawla

guidance.statement: We plan to expand to around 10 to 12 stores in two to three cities.
guidance.quote: we would certainly like to expand to around 10 to 12 stores in two to three cities
guidance.speaker: Arun Narayan

guidance.statement: We will continue to deliver around 8% to 10% volume growth.
guidance.quote: This is what we have estimated, around an 8% to 10% growth. So this is what we will continue to deliver.
guidance.speaker: N. S. Raghavan

guidance.statement: CaratLane will stay at a low double-digit EBIT margin profile.
guidance.quote: they would stay there, low double -digit margin EBIT profile.
guidance.speaker: Ashok Sonthalia

guidance.statement: Tanishq expects 35 to 40 new stores for the year.
guidance.quote: purely from new stores on Tanishq, I think 35 to 40 is a reasonable range to expect.
guidance.speaker: Ajoy Chawla

guidance.statement: Watches business EBIT margin is aimed at 15% to 16% in the 1-2 year timeframe.
guidance.quote: mid -teen is a good number to aim for, 15% to 16% for the business, at least in th e 1-year, 2-year time frame.
guidance.speaker: Ashok Sonthalia

guidance.statement: Company expects to close the year with a growth of 13% to 14%.
guidance.quote: anywhere between 13% to 14%. So we will continue to do what we are doing
guidance.speaker: N. S. Raghavan

narrative_vs_numbers.management_says: Margins are expected to hover around an 11% center of gravity.
narrative_vs_numbers.numbers_say: Operating profit margins reached 14% in recent quarters (Jun and Sep 2026), outperforming the stated center of gravity.

promises.credibility: Management generally delivers on near-term growth expectations, though margins have occasionally outperformed guidance figures.

bull: Latest quarter Sep 2026 achieved a strong revenue growth of 10% YoY along with EBITDA up 59%.
PAT surged by 114% in the latest quarter Sep 2026, supported by a margin of 14.5%.
Jewellery business operating profit margin for Jun and Sep 2026 reached 14.0%, exceeding the target center of gravity.
bear: Growth is slowing down significantly as the 5-year revenue CAGR of 32% dropped to 29% over 3 years.
Working capital is stretching with the cash conversion cycle increasing from 171 to 211 days.
5-year cumulative cash flow from operations is weak at 0.43x PAT, totaling ₹7,390 Cr versus ₹17,378 Cr.
bull_bear.what_would_change_my_mind: Evidence that cash conversion days reverse, CFO matches PAT, and long-term revenue growth reaccelerates.
